themes_detail.label: Street Deterioration Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 90 THIS WEEK, a 437% increase versus 16.8 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 9.38), suggesting a sudden infrastructure failure or widespread pothole/pavement collapse in CD 208.
evidence: 90 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 16.8 weekly baseline (437% spike, z-score 9.38)
Highest statistical z-score among all detected spikes, indicating extreme anomaly
Aligns with community board's stated priority: 'Improve traffic and pedestrian safety, including traffic calming' (repeated budget request)
reporting_angles: Map the 90 complaints geographically—is there a specific corridor or neighborhood pocket with concentrated damage?
Interview DOT about emergency repairs underway; obtain before/after photos and repair timelines
Talk to residents about safety risks: Are cars getting damaged? Are elderly residents at fall risk?

themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions & Rodent Surge
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints jumped 86% LAST WEEK (62 vs. 33.4 weekly average, z-score 4.6), and rodent complaints peaked 2 WEEKS AGO at 210% above baseline (12 vs. 3.9 average, z-score 4.43), suggesting a localized public health and sanitation crisis.
evidence: 62 unsanitary condition complaints LAST WEEK vs. 33.4 weekly average (86% increase, z-score 4.6)
12 rodent complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 3.9 weekly average (210% spike, z-score 4.43)
Dumpster complaints also spiked 500% three weeks ago (3 vs. 0.5 average, z-score 5.0), suggesting trash management breakdown
reporting_angles: Investigate waste collection schedule changes or missed pickups; interview Sanitation Department
Map rodent and unsanitary complaints to identify if problem is building-specific or district-wide
Report on health department inspections and violations; are restaurants, schools, or residential buildings cited?

themes_detail.label: Commercial Noise Disturbances
themes_detail.summary: Commercial noise complaints surged 286% LAST WEEK (14 vs. 3.6 weekly average, z-score 5.2), indicating a new or worsening source of disruptive activity in the district.
evidence: 14 commercial noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 3.6 weekly baseline (286% increase, z-score 5.2)
Distinct from residential noise (1,677 total complaints over 90 days), suggesting emerging commercial problem
311 data does not specify complaint locations, creating gap in pinpointing source
reporting_angles: Obtain granular 311 complaint locations and times to identify specific business or venue
Interview affected residents in hotspot areas; check for new bars, nightclubs, construction, or event venues
Review NYPD and community board records for prior noise enforcement actions

themes_detail.label: Sewer & Plumbing System Stress
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints jumped 248% LAST WEEK (10 vs. 2.9 weekly average, z-score 4.41) alongside ongoing elevated plumbing complaints (391 total over 90 days), suggesting aging infrastructure strain or a localized system failure.
evidence: 10 sewer complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.9 weekly average (248% spike, z-score 4.41)
391 plumbing complaints over 90 days suggests chronic issue; unclear if this week saw acceleration
Heat/hot water complaints (3,850 over 90 days) may reflect aging building systems district-wide
reporting_angles: Interview DEP about sewer overflows, collapses, or maintenance work in Riverdale/Fieldston this week
Contact community board about aging infrastructure priorities and capital budget allocations
Report on whether buildings are failing inspections due to plumbing/sewer issues

themes_detail.label: Building Code & Use Violations
themes_detail.summary: Building/use complaints spiked 586% LAST WEEK (6 vs. 0.9 weekly average, z-score 6.57), indicating possible illegal occupancy, unpermitted construction, or code violations emerging in the district.
evidence: 6 building/use complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly baseline (586% increase, z-score 6.57)
282 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (172 alterations, 63 new buildings) suggest active construction environment
5 active SNAD (Special Needs Assessment District) and permit applications in pipeline; unclear if related
reporting_angles: Obtain specific 311 building/use complaint details; cross-reference with DOB violation database
Check if complaints cluster around active construction sites or development applications
Interview DOB and community board about enforcement priorities in Riverdale/Fieldston
